description: Fetch a Bitcoin transaction by txid and return a structured, agent-ready summary: type (P2WPKH/P2TR/P2SH/etc.), input/output counts, fees, fee rate in sat/vB, confirmation status, RBF flag, SegWit/Taproot flags, and a one-line agent_summary string ready for LLM context injection. Saves 500-2000 tokens vs parsing raw TX JSON. Price: 25 sats per call.

l402_proof.description: L402 payment proof "<macaroon>:<preimage>". Omit on the first call; an unpaid call returns a 25 sat Lightning invoice and the macaroon. Pay the invoice, then repeat the call with this argument set.

name: tx_decode_explain
